label: Support the stream
purposeEn: Funds go to DTRT Lab funding, personal growth funding, and helping support small businesses in Puerto Rico. Voluntary. Not a purchase. Not tax-deductible.
purposeEs: Los fondos van a la financiación de DTRT Lab, al crecimiento personal y a ayudar a apoyar pequeños negocios en Puerto Rico. Voluntario. No es una compra. No es deducible de impuestos.

methods.name: Ko-fi
methods.noteEn: One-time and monthly tips. Available payment methods appear at checkout.
methods.noteEs: Propinas únicas y mensuales. Los métodos de pago disponibles aparecen al pagar.

methods.name: Card / Apple Pay (Stripe link)
methods.noteEn: One hosted page. Can offer monthly tiers.
methods.noteEs: Una página alojada. Puede ofrecer niveles mensuales.

tiers.note: Monthly tiers appear only after Ian creates them on Ko-fi/Stripe/BMC; amounts are set there, never on this site.
